name: Spirit Ward Expansion
body:
Prerequisite(s): Nganga level 8th, Spirit Ward class feature

Benefit(s): The radius of your Spirit Ward ability increases by 10 feet. Additionally, allies within your Spirit Ward gain a +1 sacred bonus to saving throws against fear and death effects.

Special: You can take this feat twice. The effects stack.
